title: Zed Idler — Generated Zombie Encounter Affliction Mapping
status: Design proposal; no game data or runtime behavior changed
interpretation: Afflictions possessed by the zombie are fixed/optional enemy traits. Effects inflicted on the survivor and encounter are listed separately. Structural traits and noise are not automatically survivor statuses.
source_precedence: The supplied image prompts determine the artwork's existing tier and visual identity.
Use named records in the current bestiary-data.js to anchor existing enemy identities and resolve original runtime IDs.
Enemy_Mechanics TypesTraits supplies candidate trait tier bands. Named bestiary examples already contain lower-tier exceptions.
A new lower-tier version is explicitly marked minor/proposed. It must not silently inherit the entire full-tier effect.
Conflicting source mechanics, proc rates, durations, damage and immunity scope require a separate balance decision; this mapping sets no new numeric combat values.

source_files.role: Current named roster, tier intent, mechanics and original runtime IDs
Trait names, candidate tier bands and qualitative mechanics
Affliction descriptions and cautions; numerical values not adopted

tier_policy.rule: Tutorial bodies and cosmetic conditions. At most one minor contact/passive hazard. No severe infection, hard control or surprise elemental aura.
One clear new threat. Use explicitly reduced variants for mechanics whose full versions belong later. No optional random combat traits in this set.
tier_policy.examples: One alarm, pounce, short dash, small electrical hit, localized armor or mild mold contact.

tier_policy.rule: One primary mechanic with an obvious counter; a modest supporting passive is acceptable.
tier_policy.examples: Frostbite slow, light sensitivity, barbs, ranged bone attacks and limited burrowing/acid variants.

tier_policy.rule: Combine a primary threat with its visible support traits. Add a second mechanic only when it has a separate tell.
tier_policy.examples: Immolation, Conductive, Acid Vomit + Oozing, Chrome Dome and Grayscales.

tier_policy.rule: Two complementary combat problems. Choose at most one compatible optional trait at spawn and display it.
tier_policy.examples: Armor + heavy attacks, chains + control, dash + fire, acid + a warned pressure sac.

tier_policy.rule: Larger threats with several authored identity traits. At most one optional trait; retain a usable counter.
tier_policy.examples: Giant + armor + fire, toxic bulk, repeated dash, burrow ambush and surgical infection.

tier_policy.rule: Authored miniboss combinations and clear special attacks. Choose optional variants before combat. Mid-fight changes require an explicit mutation/phase mechanic.
tier_policy.examples: Four-arm blade guard, furnace armor, dimensional phasing, prison control and elite freezing specials.

tier_policy.rule: Scripted forms and phase-specific afflictions. Show immunity and every form change. Avoid applying the full combined list at once.
tier_policy.examples: Numbness on the chained boss, exposed neural core, fire blade, plasma sphere, regeneration and separate Apex forms.

global_rules: A row's optional traits are alternatives, not an instruction to apply every trait. Normal B/A encounters select at most one. S variants select at encounter setup.
Any optional trait requires a matching visible overlay or animation before it can roll. If its tell is absent, it is unavailable for that artwork.
Treat armor as one layer for the same material. Thicker Armor replaces Armored when listed as a replacement.
Numbness is authored disable immunity, not a blanket boss property or random high-tier roll. It does not grant damage immunity.
A visor or helmet does not grant Chrome Dome. A complete sealed metal head does.
A leap or levitating key pose does not by itself grant Trap Sidestep or universal trap immunity.
Immolation, Frostbite and Conductive indicate elemental attacks. Electrical damage does not automatically stun, and ordinary cold hits do not automatically freeze.
Poison, Burn, Chill and contamination require their own mechanics and feedback. Colors alone cannot add a new damage/status type.
The source Sharp trait has both damage-only and Bleed interpretations. Bleed applications here are proposed and remain conditional on selecting that interpretation.
Grayscales is a petrifying infection. Ghostlike shimmer is not an alternate definition of Grayscales.
Thorns returns melee damage; Bleed is not automatically added. Barbed armor in the Warden counter column refers to player equipment.
Repeated control needs a visible recovery interval/protection. Do not translate a Stun-locker label into indefinite loss of control.
No rates, durations, damage multipliers, resistance percentages, spawn weights or status cure recipes are newly balanced here.
Expanded prompt IDs 49–108 are artwork/reference IDs. This document does not claim those entries already exist in the 45-record runtime roster.

expanded.name: Soggy Slump
expanded.visual_evidence: Wet rags and falling droplets.
expanded.counterplay: Blunt attacks or range.
expanded.design_note: Use the existing Damp Lurker tutorial treatment. Wetness does not grant an electric attack.

expanded.name: Ashen Wanderer
expanded.visual_evidence: Ash-grey skin, burnt cloth and faint shoulder smoke.
expanded.counterplay: Ordinary melee or range.
expanded.design_note: No active Immolation or burning aura at F. Smoke is a visual condition.

expanded.name: Lumbering Courier
expanded.visual_evidence: Torn mailbag, loose straps and worn clothing.
expanded.counterplay: Ordinary melee.
expanded.design_note: The bag identifies the courier. Stuffed Pockets and bonus loot are not automatically granted.

expanded.name: Tangled Drifter
expanded.visual_evidence: Loose rope and wire around the body.
expanded.counterplay: Ordinary melee.
expanded.design_note: Bindings are cosmetic at F. They do not grant Shackle, stun-locking or trap immunity.

expanded.name: Frail Husk
expanded.visual_evidence: Extremely thin frame and exposed ribs.
expanded.counterplay: Ordinary melee.
expanded.design_note: Frail means a brittle enemy body. It does not cause a Weakness status on the survivor.

expanded.name: Siren Stumper
expanded.visual_evidence: Broken red-glowing megaphone.
expanded.counterplay: Interrupt or defeat before the call completes.
expanded.design_note: E introduces one bounded alarm. Full horde calls and group-buff combinations belong to stronger variants. Noise is an encounter effect, not a survivor affliction.

expanded.name: Cinder Runner
expanded.visual_evidence: Low running stride and ember trail.
expanded.counterplay: Distance, interception and well-timed traps.
expanded.design_note: One short dash. Embers remain cosmetic at E; no continuous fire trail, Immolation aura or guaranteed first strike.

expanded.name: Muck Lurker
expanded.visual_evidence: Low crawl, swamp sludge and dripping limbs.
expanded.counterplay: Awareness and range.
expanded.design_note: Introduce the low ambush approach. Do not add poison, contamination and stealth bonuses simultaneously.

expanded.name: Hollow Leaper
expanded.visual_evidence: Lean airborne pounce and lightweight cloth.
expanded.counterplay: Interrupt the landing or use a net.
expanded.design_note: One readable pounce. Airborne art alone does not grant blanket floor-trap immunity.

expanded.name: Rusted Guard
expanded.visual_evidence: Orange-rusted chest plate with exposed limbs.
expanded.counterplay: Target uncovered areas or use blunt attacks.
expanded.design_note: Localized defense only. Full Armored blade/firearm resistance is a later mechanic.

expanded.name: Spore Carrier
expanded.visual_evidence: Bulging fungal growths on the shoulders and back.
expanded.counterplay: Range and avoiding contact.
expanded.design_note: Use the low-intensity Moldy treatment. Full Fungei-layden spore clouds, hallucination and swarm combinations are withheld.

expanded.name: Static Shuffler
expanded.visual_evidence: A few electric-blue fingertip sparks.
expanded.counterplay: Spacing and insulation.
expanded.design_note: No repeated reactive burst, chain lightning or stun-lock. The minor version is a proposed E introduction.

expanded.name: Goo Vomiter
expanded.visual_evidence: Translucent green stomach and drooling mouth.
expanded.counterplay: Strafe the projectile and use appropriate protection.
expanded.design_note: Single small spit with one damage-over-time effect. Full spray, persistent pools and Hazardous combinations are reserved for C or higher.

expanded.name: Shatter-Bone Bruiser
expanded.visual_evidence: Enlarged bone-covered arms.
expanded.counterplay: Blunt attacks and recovery-window punishes.
expanded.design_note: Heavy already has a D-tier precedent. Bone protection is modest. Do not infer automatic Bash stuns or Numbness.

expanded.name: Grave Digger
expanded.visual_evidence: Broken shovel, grave dirt and digging posture.
expanded.counterplay: Watch the disturbed earth and punish resurfacing.
expanded.design_note: Short, visible digging reposition only. Full unseen rear ambushes are withheld at D.

expanded.name: Wire-Bound Crawler
expanded.visual_evidence: Tight coils of barbed wire.
expanded.counterplay: Range or blunt attacks.
expanded.design_note: Wire can punish close contact. It does not automatically grant Shackle or Stun-locker. Damage return is not automatically Bleed.

expanded.name: Frost Smite
expanded.visual_evidence: White frost crystals and cold vapor.
expanded.counterplay: Fire, blunt attacks and cold resistance.
expanded.design_note: Use the existing D-tier Frostbitten Shuffler precedent. No hard freeze at this tier.

expanded.name: Flash-Blind Stalker
expanded.visual_evidence: Cowering posture and an arm shielding the face.
expanded.counterplay: Bright light or UV.
expanded.design_note: Light sensitivity weakens the zombie. The zombie does not inflict Blind simply because its own eyes are light-sensitive.

expanded.name: Decay Launcher
possible_effects_on_survivor_or_encounte: Bleed buildup if the Sharp status interpretation is adopted
expanded.visual_evidence: Raised jagged bone projectile.
expanded.counterplay: Cover and lateral movement.
expanded.design_note: The existing D-tier Sharp sniper supports the ranged identity. Sharp's damage-only and Bleed definitions conflict in the source sheets; Bleed is an explicit proposal.

expanded.name: Riot Pacifier
expanded.visual_evidence: Dented riot shield, helmet and exposed flanks.
expanded.counterplay: Flank, disarm the shield or use blunt attacks.
expanded.design_note: Directional guard rather than full Armored immunity. The C-tier defense remains readable and bypassable.

expanded.name: Thermite Walker
expanded.visual_evidence: White-yellow chemical flame streams.
expanded.counterplay: Water/foam, distance and fire protection.
expanded.design_note: C-tier Immolation already exists in the original bestiary. No silent damage-reflection trait unless spikes and a separate Thorns tell are added.

expanded.name: Plague Matron
expanded.visual_evidence: Tattered robes, infested torso and crawling larvae.
expanded.counterplay: Area attacks and distance.
expanded.design_note: One small larval swarm mechanic. Full Hermit multi-hit attacks and Wretched intimidation are withheld.

expanded.name: Volt Surger
expanded.visual_evidence: Visible torso ring of electricity and conductive fittings.
expanded.counterplay: Insulation and spacing.
expanded.design_note: Use the existing C-tier Shock Conductor precedent. Electrical damage does not automatically add a stun. Damp requires a visible wet overlay when selected.

expanded.name: Slag Enforcer
possible_effects_on_survivor_or_encounte: Burn only when Immolation is active
expanded.visual_evidence: Dark slag plates with orange cracks.
expanded.counterplay: Blunt attacks and exposed seams.
expanded.design_note: Tough Skin gives the C version a defense without the full B-tier Armored package. Activate flames and a hazard icon before adding Immolation.

expanded.name: Corrosive Bloat
expanded.visual_evidence: Bright yellow-green fluid leaking from joints.
expanded.counterplay: Strafe, range and chemical protection.
expanded.design_note: A C-tier Acid Spitter analogue. Acid burn is chemical damage and does not imply a separate fire-element aura.

expanded.name: Leaping Strangle-Imp
possible_effects_on_survivor_or_encounte: Bleed buildup if Sharp uses the proposed status behavior
expanded.visual_evidence: Outstretched claws and aggressive airborne lunge.
expanded.counterplay: Interception, reach and timing.
expanded.design_note: A clear lunge plus claw threat. No floor-trap immunity from a single airborne frame.

expanded.name: Phantasm Walker
expanded.visual_evidence: Pale cyan-grey body and shimmering outline.
expanded.counterplay: Prevent contact; use the established surgeon cure for Grayscales.
expanded.design_note: ART CUE REQUIRED: add visible grey scale plaques before using the infection mechanic. Shimmer alone does not establish petrification, intangibility or damage immunity.

expanded.name: Exoskeleton Remnant
expanded.visual_evidence: Military exoskeleton, pistons and metal limbs.
expanded.counterplay: Blunt or armor-piercing attacks; target joints.
expanded.design_note: The mechanical frame supports physical defense. It does not automatically imply Conductive shocks.

expanded.name: Blight Screamer
possible_effects_on_survivor_or_encounte: Intimidation damage debuff only if Wretched is selected
expanded.visual_evidence: Distended shrieking jaw and sound-wave pixels.
expanded.counterplay: Interrupt the shriek and prioritize the caller.
expanded.design_note: Noise plus group support is the B-tier combination. Wretched needs a distinct debuff cue. Do not add an unrelated infection because the name includes Blight.

expanded.name: Needle-Limb Freak
possible_effects_on_survivor_or_encounte: Bleed buildup if Sharp uses the proposed status behavior
expanded.visual_evidence: Long needle-like bone forearms.
expanded.counterplay: Range, traps and avoiding the stabbing line.
expanded.design_note: Bone blades support the Sharp family. Extra limbs, regenerative flesh and elemental damage are not inferred.

expanded.name: Gloom Assassin
expanded.visual_evidence: Low crouch and shadow-absorbing rags.
expanded.counterplay: Awareness, area reveal and interception.
expanded.design_note: Choose at most one optional trait. Stealth affects detection and never grants permanent invulnerability.

expanded.name: Chain-Whip Warden
possible_effects_on_survivor_or_encounte: Stress or scare on qualifying hits
expanded.visual_evidence: Spiked chain whip, wrist restraints and heavy stance.
expanded.counterplay: Reach, spacing and the established barbed-armor counter.
expanded.design_note: The original B-tier Warden is the precedent. Apply control recovery protection so repeated hits cannot create an endless stun chain.

expanded.name: Caustic Mortar
expanded.visual_evidence: Swollen dorsal reservoir and an arcing fluid attack.
expanded.counterplay: Move after the launch tell and avoid the landing area.
expanded.design_note: Pressurized is optional only with an additional visible pressure pulse and rupture warning. A large sac alone does not make the enemy explode.

expanded.name: Cryo Executioner
possible_effects_on_survivor_or_encounte: Bleed buildup only if Sharp is selected
expanded.visual_evidence: Large ice-encrusted cleaver and frost-covered body.
expanded.counterplay: Disarm, cold protection and attack recovery windows.
expanded.design_note: A cleaver adds the held-weapon counter. Any Sharp roll needs a separate readable blade/bleed cue. No routine hard freeze.

expanded.name: Napalm Stalker
expanded.visual_evidence: Forward sprint with a blazing trailing fire path.
expanded.counterplay: Spacing, fire protection and intercepting the dash.
expanded.design_note: If Blood Frenzy is selected, show a clear rage transition. Do not add Heavy to the fast runner package.

expanded.name: Centipede Host
possible_effects_on_survivor_or_encounte: Bleed buildup only if Sharp is selected
expanded.visual_evidence: Segmented lower limbs beneath the humanoid torso.
expanded.counterplay: Reach, flank attacks and limb targeting.
expanded.design_note: The image uses multiple walking legs. The source Hexapod describes a six-arm guard wall. Keep that distinction explicit rather than silently granting the full guard mechanic.

expanded.name: Apex Hunter
possible_effects_on_survivor_or_encounte: Bleed buildup only if Sharp is selected
expanded.visual_evidence: Long claws, repeated dash afterimages and forward acceleration.
expanded.counterplay: First-strike interception, reach and predictable choke points.
expanded.design_note: Choose at most one optional trait. Battle Hunger improves the enemy's accuracy rather than afflicting the player.

expanded.name: Slag Titan
expanded.visual_evidence: Huge molten-slag body with glowing fissures.
expanded.counterplay: Blunt or armor-piercing attacks, fire protection and recovery windows.
expanded.design_note: Four identity tags create two clear problems: physical bulk and close-range heat. No random Numbness.

expanded.name: Toxic Behemoth
possible_effects_on_survivor_or_encounte: Contact contamination only if Oozing is selected
expanded.visual_evidence: Bulky body within dense green gas.
expanded.counterplay: Distance, breathing protection and appropriate fire ignition.
expanded.design_note: The gas identity is primary. Do not also add a piercing explosion without a pressure tell.

expanded.name: Bio-Electric Monstrosity
expanded.visual_evidence: Yellow-white arcs over exposed muscles.
expanded.counterplay: Insulation and range.
expanded.design_note: Strong adds regeneration only when a healing pulse/reforming-tissue cue is displayed. No automatic stun or shock immunity.

expanded.name: Subterranean Stalker
possible_effects_on_survivor_or_encounte: Bleed buildup if Sharp uses the proposed status behavior
expanded.visual_evidence: Half-submerged body, disturbed earth and razor mandibles.
expanded.counterplay: Awareness, prediction and the resurfacing window.
expanded.design_note: Full A-tier burrow-and-ambush behavior is appropriate. Underground avoidance is temporary and tied to the burrow state.

expanded.name: Surgical Abomination
possible_effects_on_survivor_or_encounte: Bleed buildup if Sharp uses the proposed status behavior
expanded.visual_evidence: Grafted scalpels, steel implements and grey flesh.
expanded.counterplay: Avoid contact; disarm tools; use the established Grayscales cure.
expanded.design_note: ART CUE REQUIRED: visible scale plaques must identify the infection independently of the surgical tools. Tools do not automatically imply regeneration.

expanded.name: Dread Dreadnought
expanded.visual_evidence: Overlapping composite plating and integrated weapon scraps.
expanded.counterplay: Armor-piercing or blunt attacks; target gaps.
expanded.design_note: Thicker Armor replaces the ordinary armor trait. Avoid double-counting the same plating. No automatic headshot immunity without a sealed head.

expanded.name: Marrow Collector
possible_effects_on_survivor_or_encounte: Bleed buildup if Sharp uses the proposed status behavior
Melee damage return only if Thorns is selected
expanded.visual_evidence: Low four-limb stance with long bone blades.
expanded.counterplay: Flank, use reach and strike during committed sweeps.
expanded.design_note: Select the optional trait at encounter setup. Bone blades do not turn this four-limb design into an eight-limb wall.

expanded.name: Inferno Engine
possible_effects_on_survivor_or_encounte: Melee damage return only if Thorns is selected
expanded.visual_evidence: Black spiked iron, furnace glow and heat effects.
expanded.counterplay: Fire protection, armor counters and range.
expanded.design_note: Spikes visibly support Thorns. Keep fire damage and reflected melee damage distinct in the encounter display.

expanded.name: Void Phantom
expanded.visual_evidence: Violet distortion and faint duplicate afterimages.
expanded.counterplay: Reveal, track the real silhouette and attack during the solid phase.
expanded.design_note: Phasing has a visible start and end. No permanent invulnerability, petrification or hidden curse is assigned.

expanded.name: Grave Overlord
expanded.visual_evidence: Necrotic crown, burial robes and a summoning hand.
expanded.counterplay: Interrupt support actions and use area damage on the escort.
expanded.design_note: An authored command-and-escort encounter. A crown does not justify unrelated elemental damage.

expanded.name: Epitaph Warden
possible_effects_on_survivor_or_encounte: Stress or scare on qualifying hits
expanded.visual_evidence: Black-iron prison plates, chains and red optics.
expanded.counterplay: Armor counters, reach and control-recovery protection.
expanded.design_note: A stronger Warden package. Red optics are a tell, not evidence of fire damage or disable immunity.

expanded.name: Toxin Sovereign
expanded.visual_evidence: Ruined hazmat layers, green reactor core and pressurized fumes.
expanded.counterplay: Breathing protection, distance and reactor recovery windows.
expanded.design_note: Pressurized requires a dedicated rupture warning. Do not assume every reactor attack causes an explosion.

expanded.name: Storm Caller
expanded.visual_evidence: Slight levitation and a blue plasma vortex.
expanded.counterplay: Insulation and gaps in the electrical pattern.
expanded.design_note: Airborne protection applies only to floor contact during that state. Nets, ranged attacks and every other trap are not automatically negated.

expanded.name: Glacial Leviathan
possible_effects_on_survivor_or_encounte: Brief Freeze only on a proposed telegraphed special
expanded.visual_evidence: Thick blue plates and giant ice-spike fists.
expanded.counterplay: Cold protection, armor counters and recovery windows.
expanded.design_note: Freeze is an elite special proposal, not the default effect of every cold hit. Provide a recovery interval.

expanded.name: The Iron Titan
expanded.visual_evidence: Industrial hydraulics, broken golden chains and enormous fists.
expanded.counterplay: Armor counters, sustained damage and avoiding the heavy swing.
expanded.design_note: Numbness is an authored boss trait inherited from the Chained Behemoth concept. Display disable immunity explicitly. It does not mean damage immunity.

expanded.name: The Hivemind Core
expanded.visual_evidence: Eight neural tentacles around a pulsing organic core.
expanded.counterplay: Sever/disable a committed tentacle and attack the exposed core.
expanded.design_note: Red core light does not mean fire or electricity. Mutation changes are signalled between authored phases.

expanded.name: The Ash Emperor
expanded.visual_evidence: Liquid-fire blade, burning mantle and cracked magma underfoot.
expanded.counterplay: Fire protection, blade recovery windows and spacing.
expanded.design_note: Use fire-themed phases. Magma is a local hazard. No separate Bleed, poison or permanent curse is inferred.

expanded.name: The Void Harbinger
expanded.visual_evidence: Shifting geometric body and visible dimensional distortion.
expanded.counterplay: Track the current form and exploit the solid phase.
expanded.design_note: State changes alter attack patterns. Spatial damage, permanent curses and new status systems remain unassigned.

expanded.name: The Undying Goliath
expanded.visual_evidence: Regenerating torn flesh under green flames.
expanded.counterplay: Interrupt the healing window and use fire protection.
expanded.design_note: Green fire is still fire. Poison, radiation and Corruption are not granted by its color.

expanded.name: The Storm Sovereign
expanded.visual_evidence: A massive crackling plasma sphere.
expanded.counterplay: Insulation and sphere charge/release windows.
expanded.design_note: The sphere is an authored boss attack. Stun and Numbness are not automatically bundled with electrical damage.

expanded.name: The Plague Archon
expanded.visual_evidence: Rolling plague mist and visible spore swarms.
expanded.counterplay: Breathing protection, clearing space and targeting exposed windows.
expanded.design_note: Share the poison damage budget between mist and spores. Do not silently multiply damage by counting the same cloud twice. Hallucination is not selected.

expanded.name: The Sub-Zero Colossus
possible_effects_on_survivor_or_encounte: Brief Freeze only on a proposed telegraphed special
expanded.visual_evidence: Crystallized air, blizzard aura and massive ice plates.
expanded.counterplay: Cold protection and the gaps after blizzard attacks.
expanded.design_note: Phase-based freezing with a recovery interval. Ice armor does not imply Numbness or universal disable immunity.

expanded.name: The Apex Prime
possible_effects_on_survivor_or_encounte: Bleed buildup only during the Sharp pursuit form
expanded.visual_evidence: Sleek armored mutation, changing limbs and distinct form transitions.
expanded.counterplay: Respond to the active form: intercept pursuit, pierce bastion armor, punish mutation transitions.
expanded.design_note: Use authored forms rather than all traits at once. Pursuit: Dash + Sharp. Bastion: Armored + Heavy Hitter. Unstable: Hybrid-Limbed + Rebis, with a signalled Blood Frenzy transition.
